mentions.name: Interpretable programmable toy-scale language model
mentions.description: A toy-scale language model that learns to predict words from text, designed to be explicitly interpretable and programmable: what it has learned is directly visible, and users can teach it new things without retraining.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on a novel (toy scale) kind of LM that is explicitly interpretable and programmable. In that it learns to predict words from text and you can directly see what it learned and teach it new things without retraining.
